name: wp-plus-sign-preserved
description: [PLUGIN BEHAVIOR] getQueryParams decodes values with decodeURIComponent only, so '+' stays literal. The TS engine uses URLSearchParams, which decodes '+' as space.
quirk_decision: DISAGREEMENT: plugin stores 'best+clinic' (decodeURIComponent, clicutcl-attribution.js:430-437); engine stores 'best clinic'. Conflicts with golden fixture google-ads-utm-gclid which assumes engine behavior.
